title: Natural two-way voice tutoring with interruption and safe actions
whatBuilt: Two-way voice session over the same authorized session with EXPLICIT mic consent/status and a QUALIFIED locale (composes the AI-18 qualification seam); no always-on recording, raw audio never retained, no voice cloning, no automatic raw-audio training
Interim transcripts are never input; only FINAL recognized speech advances, keyed by audio sequence ids; STALE (reordered/old) audio is suppressed
Interruption/stop/cancel are bounded and acknowledged (cancels the in-flight turn)
Uncertain numbers/units require a READBACK confirmation before they become input (never auto-committed)

SAFE ACTIONS allowlist-only; consequential Build accept/share/export require an explicit confirm bound to the EXACT project revision (revision-moved blocks); final speech is input, never assessment or permission authority
Reconnect reauthorizes (consent + no revocation); account switch denied; turn/token/concurrency/deadline bounds enforced

provenEndToEnd.openConsentQualification: mic-consent required, qualified locale required, concurrency bound enforced
provenEndToEnd.interimVsFinal: interim never input; only final advances; reordered/old audio rejected (stale_audio)
provenEndToEnd.interruption: interrupt acknowledged and cancels the in-flight turn
provenEndToEnd.readback: uncertain number/unit stays awaiting_readback until confirmed (never auto-committed)
provenEndToEnd.safeActions: allowlist-only; build-accept without confirm -> action_requires_confirm; wrong revision -> revision_moved; exact-revision confirm allowed
provenEndToEnd.reauthorizePrivacy: reconnect re-checks consent/revocation (revoked fails closed); wrong user denied; raw audio never retained, no cloning/training

verification.voicesessionCheck: npm run voicesession:check -> 7/7 tests pass (compile tsconfig.voicesession.json + node --test)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
notes: Native prerequisites per ticket: KAN-156, KAN-92, KAN-143, KAN-90, KAN-89, KAN-139 (all in Testing). This is the voice-session CONTRACT framework; the ASR/TTS/locale/provider adapters remain seams to be supplied at integration, and real-device/interruption/mic-loss/poor-network proofs require released hardware and qualified provider runs. No voice/provider/hosted/commercial/coverage gate is claimed closed by this work.
